decision.explanation: The wireless headphones were delivered broken, reported within the 7-day electronics return window. Per policy E3 and E5, a full refund including shipping can be issued, but since the item price is above ₹500 and no photo evidence was provided (requirement E6 applies for price > ₹2000, but this item is ₹2499 so evidence photo is required), photo evidence is missing and cannot be uploaded now. Without evidence, we cannot proceed with an immediate refund. Hence, per policy, we schedule a return pickup first and refund will be processed after pickup completion. User consent for scheduling return and refund is needed before proceeding.
